Chapter 980 Chapter 1: Chaos Great Saint (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 980  Chapter 1: Chaos Great Saint (Please Subscribe)

Martial Arts Evolution Tower.

Majestic and colossal, soaring ten light-years high, it stands at the very heart of human civilization, receiving the adoration of countless beings day and night.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged at the deepest level of the tower, in a vast world where not far off, eighteen mysterious trees were planted, their branches swaying in the gentle breeze.

These eighteen mysterious trees, drawing in Chaos Qi, emitted an oppressive aura not weaker than any at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.

"These trees can directly absorb Chaos Qi without refining or purifying, due to a special corresponding structure within them..."

Lin Yuan thought, as many insights sparked in his mind.

When he reached the Second Layer, upon obtaining these eighteen dominion-level mysterious trees, Lin Yuan had been quite curious about their ability to directly absorb and exhale Chaos Qi and conducted many studies.

And after stepping into the Yuan Layer, these studies were finally perfected, completing the last part, with all insights converging to form a complete and perfect Secret Technique.

[Your comprehension is heaven-defying, observing the mysterious trees absorbing Chaos Qi, you have comprehended a Secret Technique for direct absorption of Chaos Qi...]

A Secret Technique took shape in Lin Yuan's mind, which, essentially, was a minor adjustment to the internal world of the body, achieving an effect similar to that of the mysterious trees' absorption of Chaos Qi.

"Finally, it's complete." A smile appeared on Lin Yuan's face. The Secret Technique enhanced his utilization and absorption of Chaos Qi, reducing his overreliance on Chaos Stones.

Those in the Path Splitting Realm could also absorb Chaos Qi, but it required many steps and was fine under normal circumstances.

But at critical moments, such as fighting an enemy, who has the time to slowly absorb Chaos Qi? That's when the effect of Chaos Stones becomes evident.

Chaos Stones, refined personally by a Chaos Venerable, contain extremely pure Chaos Qi, ready for direct absorption.

Now, Lin Yuan could also directly absorb Chaos Qi.

"The greatest help this Secret Technique offers me is the insight into Chaos Qi..." Lin Yuan looked thoughtful.

Chaos Qi is the ubiquitous energy of the Chaos Void, the foundation of everything. It's often overlooked by Yuan Layer beings due to its commonality.

....

On the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming, within Mingchuan City.

In an inn.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, as the aura of his physical body slowly stabilized.

"With my current application of Chaos Qi, the avatars I can manifest are strong enough to bring my combat power to the peak of the Path Splitting Realm."

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan's face.

Previously, when suppressing dozens of alien Yuan Layer beings within the cosmos, the dozens of avatars Lin Yuan conjured had only nearly reached the peak strength of the Path Splitting Realm.

Approximately at the level of a Xuanyuan Supreme, a Myriad Transformation Queen, or perhaps a bit stronger.

But now, it had reached the absolute peak of the Path Splitting Realm.

One must know that being 'nearly at the peak' and 'at the peak' of the Path Splitting Realm is entirely different.

The Xuanyuan Supreme and Myriad Transformation Queen have been close to the peak of the Path Splitting Realm for a long time, but whether they can step into the peak before the great collapse of this cosmos is still uncertain.

Most likely, they cannot.

The ultimate beings of the Robber Clan are at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm because they have cultivated for more than one Cosmic Era.

Normally, it is hard for even hundreds or thousands of Cosmic Eras to give birth to one at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm within the cosmos.

"I still need to be careful; this isn't the cosmos after all."

Lin Yuan scanned his surroundings, his excited spirit quickly calming down.

Within the cosmos, Lin Yuan was invincible, sweeping through everything, but on this Ancient Ming Chaos Continent?

Forget about an avatar at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, even his true body, an entity comparable to dominion-level beings, must not act too recklessly.

Dominion-level beings are indeed powerful in the Chaos Void, but this is the Chaos Continent, presided over by a Chaos Venerable, attracting a massive congregation of Yuan Layer beings from the surrounding vast regions, where Path Splitting Realm beings are common, and there are quite a few dominions.

There are even the occasional Chaos Realm passers-by.

"Hm?"

"Is someone looking for me?"

Lin Yuan's expression changed slightly as he looked outside the inn.

"I've been immersing myself in bitter cultivation ever since I arrived on this Chaos Continent; who would be looking for me?" Lin Yuan was quite astonished.

After pondering for a moment, Lin Yuan got up and moved to another area.

The inn was like a small world unto itself, with various distinct areas.

"I have seen the great sir." The one seeking Lin Yuan was a gentle-looking and respectfully poised woman.

Lin Yuan immediately recognized her as a Second Layer being, with the symbol of the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent embossed on her sleeve, indicating that she served under the Ancient Ming Venerable.

Of course, she was not under the direct command of the Ancient Ming Venerable, but she was certainly working for him.

"What's the matter?" Lin Yuan asked directly.

"Reporting to the great sir, half a year from now, is the 'Thousand Treasures Convention' in our Mingchuan City, where many rarely seen treasures will appear. I am commanded by the city lord to offer you a 'Thousand Treasures Record', which lists the treasures that will be available for sale at the convention."

The woman took out a book.

"Understood." Lin Yuan replied unemotionally, taking the book from her.

"Then I shall take my leave." The woman immediately excused herself.

Lin Yuan browsed the 'Thousand Treasures Record', looking over the many treasures listed.

The reason Mingchuan City gave him this 'Thousand Treasures Record'... was naturally to give Lin Yuan ample time to prepare and gather Chaos Stones.

Knowing in advance the treasures that would appear at the Thousand Treasures Convention, if there was something he desperately desired, he could prepare beforehand.

"The 'Thousand Treasures Convention' in Mingchuan City is supported by the Ancient Ming Venerable at its back, and the credibility is highly assured, and each time the treasures that appear are quite extraordinary, attracting many strong beings from the nearby Chaos Void to participate."
